title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud

beats.text: Breaking: OpenAI just dropped a massive partnership—frontier models are officially hitting Google Cloud. This isn't a rumor; it’s happening now.
beats.visual_focus: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

visual_blueprint.title: OPENAI MODELS ARE COMING TO GOOGLE CLOUD
visual_blueprint.sub: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

motif_params.title: OPENAI MODELS ARE COMING TO GOOGLE CLOUD
motif_params.sub: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

beats.text: Previously, juggling multi-cloud stacks meant massive latency overheads and fragile, fragmented API pipelines. Developers were stuck choosing between cloud-native speed or OpenAI's reasoning dominance.
beats.visual_focus: Split screen showing fragmented data pipes.

visual_blueprint.title: ELIMINATING FRAGMENTATION
visual_blueprint.sub: Split screen showing fragmented data pipes.

motif_params.title: ELIMINATING FRAGMENTATION
motif_params.sub: Split screen showing fragmented data pipes.

beats.text: By integrating Codex workflows directly into Gemini’s Model Garden, Google Cloud now functions as a unified gateway. You get the raw reasoning power of OpenAI directly inside your VPC.
beats.visual_focus: 3D visualization of Google Cloud and OpenAI integration.

visual_blueprint.title: UNIFIED VIRTUAL PRIVATE CLOUD
visual_blueprint.sub: 3D visualization of Google Cloud and OpenAI integration.

motif_params.title: UNIFIED VIRTUAL PRIVATE CLOUD
motif_params.sub: 3D visualization of Google Cloud and OpenAI integration.

beats.text: We’re talking SOTA results. These models are pulling elite scores on SWE-bench Verified and GPQA, maintaining industry-leading reasoning performance even inside the Vertex environment.
Pricing is aggressive. By leveraging Google’s infrastructure footprint, enterprises can tap into high-throughput API tokens with reduced egress costs starting today via the Cloud Marketplace.
